messages.content: 今天美國的黃金價格是多少？

function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

maturity_years.description: The number of years to maturity of the bond.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若您想知道今天美國黃金（通常指COMEX黃金期貨或現貨）價格，建議參考以下可靠來源：

| 資料來源 | 連結 / 平台 |
|----------|-------------|
| Bloomberg | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets |
| Reuters | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities |
| Kitco | https://www.kitco.com |
| CME Group（COMEX） | https://www.cmegroup.com/trading/metal/commodity.html |
| Investing.com | https://www.investing.com/commodities |

這些網站都會在交易時間內更新黃金價格，並提供即時行情、歷史走勢圖以及相關新聞。若您需要更精確的數字，請直接前往上述平台查看最新報價。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" (What is today's gold price in the US?). They want the current price. We don't have real-time data. We can respond that we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, or the COMEX. We can provide approximate recent price if known. But we should be careful not to provide inaccurate data. We can say "I don't have real-time data, but as of last close it was around $...". But better to say we can't provide real-time. We can give a general range. Let's respond politely.
